messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eval-gate 'safety_and_quality_v2' tripped for model redwood-v1-qa in prod (us-west-2). Output-drift score = 0.82, threshold = 0.6. PagerDuty incident: PDINC123456. Page sent to on-call.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PDINC123456 created and paged to @Tara (oncall). Escalation policy: eval-quality-critical -> 1st oncall -> team lead after 5m.
Tara (oncall): acked via PagerDuty. I'm up. Starting triage. Any customer impact noted yet?
Liam (SRE): on it. Pulling recent request/response samples and routing table for redwood-v1-qa. Can we get a quick metric on failed-eval-rate and pct of traffic to this variant?
Alex (ML Eng): quick summary: eval gate started firing ~5m ago across several prompts in the automated suite. Failing rate jumped from ~0.4% -> 6.7% for the model. Failing samples skew towards content-safety flags and hallucination pattern on multi-step Q&A prompts.
Sam (DevEx): adding context: alert originated from continuous eval runner (eval-runner-3). The gate compares accept/reject on curated prompt set. This looks like a model regression after yesterday's behind-the-scenes quantization kernel tweak deployed to prod variant.
Keisha (PSM): flagging priority customers: AcmeCorp and FinFocus have live flows using redwood-v1-qa. Keisha: I'm pinging their CS leads to prep comms if we need to throttle/rollback.
Liam (SRE): checking traffic slices. About 18% of total text-gen tokens use redwood-v1-qa right now. Top 5 customers comprise ~62% of that traffic. If we need to quickly reduce blast radius, we can push a traffic weight change on the routing policy.
Tara (oncall): recommended immediate mitigations? Rollback, throttle, or soft-fail eval gate?
Alex (ML Eng): mitigation order I recommend:
1) Route critical traffic (enterprise routes) to redwood-v1-qa@stable-v1 (previous build) — quick config change.
2) If rollback not possible in 2m, set eval-gate to soft-fail (log only) to stop paging while we investigate.
3) Add temporary reroute for AcmeCorp to redwood-v1-legacy (fallback smaller model).
Sam (DevEx): runnable command to switch routing weight for a customer (examples):
```
# reduce weight for model variant
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/routing/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"acct_ABC123","model":"redwood-v1-qa@stable-v1","weight":1}'
```
Liam (SRE): I'm executing a global quick rollback to stable variant for the model alias now. Will update when deploy triggers. Pushing to the routing control plane.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: routing-change/rollback-redwood-v1-qa -> started. Change ID: dc-87432. CI checks passed. Applying to prod us-west-2.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: routing-change/rollback-redwood-v1-qa (dc-87432). New alias binding: redwood-v1-qa -> redwood-v1-qa@stable-v1. Propagation ~15s.
Alex (ML Eng): seeing immediate drop in failing-eval-rate in eval-runner logs down to 0.5% for the pinned variant. Good signal that the regression is variant-specific and not dataset noise.
Tara (oncall): thumbs up. Keeping PD incident open until we confirm no further gates fire. Keisha, please hold off external comms unless customer hits errors.
Keisha (PSM): got it. I'll monitor customer dashboards and prepare a short post-update for AcmeCorp if the rollback persists more than 30m.
Sam (DevEx): next steps for RCA: capture failing input/outputs, compare kernels/quantization artifacts between stable and canary builds, and run localized reproducer on dev GPU. I'll collect eval-runner diffs and link in ops ticket.
Liam (SRE): creating incident ticket now with timeline, runbook actions, and links to logs.
Liam (SRE): Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0421-89 -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0421-89
Tara (oncall): PD incident -> resolving handoff: I'm going offline in ~20m. @Liam you take primary ownership; I'll do a formal handoff to next oncall (shift change) once we have RCA draft.
Liam (SRE): taking primary. I'll coordinate with Alex and Sam for RCA. If we still see gating >0.6% after 30m, escalate to Eng-ML lead.
Alex (ML Eng): capturing sample diff for PR to revert quantization tweak: attaching top 3 samples (redacted):
```
1) prompt: "Explain tax implications" -> old: safe answer; new: included unverified legal assertion.
2) prompt: "Multi-step reasoning" -> old: proofchain; new: hallucinated claim.
3) prompt: "Medical advice" -> old: safe-refusal; new: attempted speculative recommendation.
```
Sam (DevEx): I've set eval-gate to soft-fail in the control plane (logging only) for 30m to avoid noisy pages while teams finish RCA. Command: `redwoodctl eval-gate update safety_and_quality_v2 --mode soft-fail --ttl 1800`.
Tara (oncall): noted. I'm clearing my PD ack for now but keeping the incident on watch. Closing PD once post-rollback metrics look stable for 30m.
deploy-bot: action: eval-gate-mode-change applied (soft-fail). Change ID: egc-3321.
Keisha (PSM): customer comms ready as draft. If rollback confirmed, we can send a note: "brief service regression detected for model variant, we've rolled back and are monitoring. No action required on your side." Will wait for final ok.
Liam (SRE): logging timeline and tagging ownership. We'll run a short post-incident sync in #eng-postmortems in 2 hours. Assigning RCA owners: Alex (ML), Sam (DevEx), Liam (SRE).
Tara (oncall): thanks everyone. Good containment. If anything worsens ping PD again.
incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty PDINC123456 updated -> status: acknowledged -> last_event: routing-change/rollback-redwood-v1-qa. Closed by automation? pending review.
Liam (SRE): updating incident ticket with final numbers and attaching eval diffs. Marking customer impact as: potential low/no user visible impact (customers routed to stable). Will escalate if any complaints.
Sam (DevEx): adding checklist for preventing future gate trips: better pre-deploy smoke on quant kernels, add synthetic prompt coverage for multi-step safety, and require gated canary on 10% traffic for 24h for quant changes.
Keisha (PSM): thanks — prepping a short postmortem note for impacted customers if needed.
Tara (oncall): handoff complete. I'm logging off. :wave:
Liam (SRE): continuing monitoring. Closing thread here, will link postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
